pick.name: Affinity (by Canva)
pick.what: Pixel, vector and layout studios in one Windows-native app
pick.why: Pro-grade and free for individuals, and runs natively on Windows; replaces Photoshop+Illustrator+InDesign.
pick.free_limits: Free for individuals; AI tools need a Canva premium plan; org SSO via Canva Enterprise
pick.windows_fit: native (best with a dedicated GPU, runs on mid-range)

alts.name: Canva (free)
alts.why: Fastest for social/marketing templates; also Claude Design export target.

alts.name: Inkscape
alts.why: Best for hand-tuning SVG logos/icons with zero licence questions.

decision: Affinity gives professional raster/vector/layout tools for $0 on Windows. Keep Canva free for quick social templates and Inkscape for SVG cleanup of the logo skill's output.
details: Affinity's free terms say 'free for individuals'; confirm commercial use by a one-person company in the EULA.

verify.note: Official site: 'Affinity is free for individuals (seriously)'; AI tools need a Canva premium plan; Windows build confirmed. Canva's Affinity terms (account-linked, per-device licence) returned 403, so commercial use by a one-person company is still NOT confirmed from a primary source. Keep commercial_ok 'unclear' until the EULA is read. Pick itself is fine for this user.
